query:
INSERT INTO "PayPeriod" ("id","scheduleId","startDate","endDate","payDate",
                                        "year","periodNum")
               VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7)
               ON CONFLICT("scheduleId","year","periodNum") DO UPDATE SET
                 "startDate" = ?3, "endDate" = ?4, "payDate" = ?5
